mercy_hour_prayer.text: You expired, Jesus, but the source of life gushed forth for souls, and an ocean of mercy opened up for the whole world. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You.
mercy_hour_prayer.source: The Diary of St. Faustina (short invocations)
